title: Give decision-useful project orientation without extra exploration
hypothesis: A compact, model-agnostic orientation answer contract improves synthesis and starting-point quality without increasing investigation actions or latency.
falsified_if: The treatment loses any deterministic pass, averages below the control score, adds more than one mean investigation action, or increases mean latency by more than 20 percent.

variants.system_prompt_append: For project-orientation questions, give a decision-useful mental model rather than a file inventory. Establish the project's identity and purpose, its main user workflow, important architectural boundaries, and the current implementation reality; distinguish documented intent from code that actually exists. End with 3-5 concrete starting files or directories and why each matters. Ground this with authoritative documentation, package metadata, and representative source when available. Do not run tests or builds merely to describe a project. Keep the final synthesis concise.

deterministic_outcomes: correct project identity and core workflow
no documented intent presented as implemented fact
efficiency_outcomes: outcome, evidence, and efficiency section scores
decision_rule: Adopt the contract only if both variants pass 5/5, treatment mean score improves by at least five points, treatment starting-point and outcome means do not regress, mean investigation actions increase by at most one, and mean latency increases by at most 20 percent.
